facts: NASA SP-8119 lists alloy 2014 in heat-treated conditions T4 and T6 as susceptible to stress corrosion.
NASA SP-8119 lists alloy 2024 in heat-treated conditions T3, T4, and T351 as susceptible to stress corrosion.
NASA SP-8119 lists alloy PH15-7Mo in heat-treated conditions RH950 and TH1050 as susceptible to stress corrosion.
NASA SP-8119 lists alloy 17-7PH in annealed and H900 conditions as susceptible to stress corrosion.
NASA SP-8119 lists alloy 17-4PH in heat-treated conditions RH950 and TH1050 as susceptible to stress corrosion.
NASA SP-8119 lists alloy AM350 in condition SCT850 as susceptible to stress corrosion.
NASA SP-8119 lists alloy AM355 in condition SCT850 as susceptible to stress corrosion.
NASA SP-8119 states that materials susceptible to stress corrosion should not be used.
